title: When MettleUp Plus starts or stops in the middle of a workout, the watch keeps its old screen until the next set
what: The phone only saves the new watch lock; it does not send the watch a fresh screen. A member who buys Plus during a workout still sees 'Your watch needs MettleUp Plus' (and gets no rest buzz) until the phone next updates the watch. A member whose free month ends during a workout keeps a working watch screen, and the phone still accepts sets logged from it, because the phone never checks the plan when a set comes from the watch.
expected: The moment the plan opens or closes, the watch screen changes to match, and sets from a locked watch are not taken.
who: members with a watch, once Plus is switched on
how_often: only when the plan changes during a workout
fix_line: When the lock changes, resend the current workout and rest to the watch, and ignore watch sets while locked

items.reason: no amount, price or receipt is typed or shown in these files; the only Plus words sent to the watch carry no price
